purpose: Identify a small, heterogeneous set of real origin-side actors where the existence, schema, ownership and reuse boundary of non-OEM maintenance/failure records can be tested without copying customer or equipment data.
what_is_not_the_missing_edge: generic repair dispatch or work-order management
surviving_missing_edge_question: Do independent aftermarket actors hold lawfully reusable, cross-actor-comparable non-OEM failure/repair traces that are not already absorbed by OEM/platform data systems, and would those traces add enough incremental value to an industrial-AI/dataset buyer to support a paid pilot?

public_counterevidence.fact: Commercial industrial-maintenance SaaS already records repair history, equipment lifecycle records, work orders, inspections, spare parts and maintenance analytics.
Commercial engineering-machinery IoT/rental management software already tracks alarms, repairs and maintenance across the equipment lifecycle.
XCMG/Hanyun already combines equipment fault data and repair data for lifecycle management and feeds those data back to manufacturer R&D.
XCMG is already a national enterprise trusted-data-space pilot, so generic data-space infrastructure is not a missing edge.
Two Xuzhou engineering-machinery high-quality dataset projects already cover second-hand machinery and vehicle-network data.

targets.name: 徐州福泰工程机械贸易有限公司
targets.public_state: Current public site describes engineering-machinery repair, parts, rentals, a 6000-square-metre site with a repair workshop, 1000+ parts inventory and 1000+ terminal users; 2026 public activity is visible.
targets.why_probe: Combines repair + parts + rental + broad terminal-user exposure, increasing the chance that repeated fault/repair traces exist outside a pure OEM telemetry stream.

targets.name: 徐州路信工程机械租赁有限公司
targets.public_state: Public site states nationwide equipment rental plus large/mid-size machinery field emergency repair, repair and maintenance services.
targets.why_probe: Own/rented equipment plus explicit field repair/maintenance makes it a direct test of whether operational traces remain local, oral/paper, or digitally retained.

targets.name: 徐州永合工程机械有限公司
targets.public_state: Current public site states equipment rental and repair, 10+ rental product types, 200+ customers and a mixed-brand fleet including Wirtgen, Vogele, Volvo, BOMAG/Hamm and other road-machinery equipment.
targets.why_probe: Mixed-brand equipment is valuable for testing whether aftermarket records contain failure/repair information not confined to one OEM data ecosystem.
unknowns: whether repair work is internal fleet-only or external

targets.name: 徐州众瑞达工程机械有限公司
targets.public_state: Current public site states 50+ equipment units, engineering-machinery rental, road construction and road maintenance/repair operations.
targets.why_probe: A fleet of 50+ units should create repeated maintenance events; this target tests the fleet-owner side even if external repair services are not the core business.

targets.name: 徐州市华通公路工程机械有限公司
targets.public_state: 2026 public references describe a currently operating road-machinery rental/construction/technical-service company with about 80 major equipment units and regular maintenance; current public business information also reports the entity as active.
targets.why_probe: Larger owned fleet offers a contrast with smaller repair/rental actors and can test whether scale produces structured maintenance data or simply internal operational records.
unknowns: whether data is already captured by OEM systems

minimum_questions: Do you keep a repair/maintenance history at all?
What medium: paper, Excel, ERP/SaaS, WeChat, technician memory, mixed?
What blank field names exist on a typical record?
Is the record linked to a specific equipment ID internally?
Do records distinguish symptom, diagnosis/root cause, action, replaced part and post-repair result?
Who legally/contractually controls the record and derived use?
Do OEM, dealer, insurer, platform or customer contracts already receive/control the same information?
Would the actor consider a separately authorized, de-identified derived dataset if there were measurable economic value?
probe_protocol.pass_gate: At least 3 of 5 actors retain non-trivial records with a minimum common schema; at least 2 have a plausible authorization path for de-identified derived use; records are not already fully absorbed by an OEM/platform contract.
probe_protocol.next_only_after_pass: Present only the abstracted common schema, not source records, to one industrial-AI/high-quality-dataset buyer and test incremental model/evaluation value plus paid-pilot intent.
probe_protocol.kill_gate: Kill if records are mostly oral/non-retained, common schema cannot be formed, rights cannot be cleared, or the same traces are already comprehensively captured by incumbent OEM/platform systems.
